::: {#def-coverage-probability}
#### Coverage probability

The **coverage probability** of an interval $[L, U]$ for a parameter $\theta$
is $\Pr(L \le \theta \le U)$,
computed over repeated samples with $\theta$ held fixed.
A $100(1-\alpha)\%$ [confidence interval](#def-confidence-interval)
has coverage probability $1 - \alpha$.
:::
